tldr: DeepSeek stole the evening: V4 Flash 0731 posts a massive agentic benchmark jump (Terminal Bench 56.9→82.7, Toolathlon +18.5) and is now touted as surpassing V4-Pro-Preview, while a Show HN proves DeepSeek distillation transfers no censorship. Huawei open-sources openPangu-2.0-Pro (505B-A18B MoE, 512K context), and Alibaba double-releases Qwen-AgentWorld (native language world model for agents) plus Qwen-Image/Qwen-Image-Edit 20B open weights. Washington had a busy AI week: the White House nears voluntary frontier release standards, the Senate punts AI legislation to fall, and 1,000+ frontier-lab staffers sign a cross-lab 'brake pedal' letter. Agent security stays a money magnet — Act Security ($60M), Mate Security ($50M), DataBahn ($40M) — while Flourish raises a $500M seed for brain-inspired AI and Aschenbrenner's hedge fund is forced to unload nearly its entire portfolio to Citadel.
